description: This file defines the Zend_Validate_Hostname class, which validates hostnames including DNS, IP, and local network names, with support for IDN and Punycode decoding.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Hostname
classes.description: A validator class for hostnames supporting DNS, IP, local names, IDN, and Punycode decoding.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with options for hostname validation, including allow types, IDN, TLD validation, and IP validation.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple validator options at once.

methods.name: getIpValidator
methods.description: Returns the current IP validator instance.

methods.name: getAllow
methods.description: Returns the current allow option bitmask.

methods.name: getValidateIdn
methods.description: Returns whether IDN validation is enabled.

methods.name: getValidateTld
methods.description: Returns whether TLD validation is enabled.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a hostname string against current options, including DNS, IP, local, IDN, and Punycode decoding.

methods.name: decodePunycode
methods.description: Decodes a Punycode-encoded string to UTF-8; returns false if decoding fails.
